body:
Ketamine always helped me embrace aspects of life differently.
I had some ketamine left after the weekend and sensed liked I was letting myself go like a piece of shit, I did actually. Perpetually avoiding my receptors.
Time to shower I snorted some, put some music on and was left in a box of imagination. I reconnected all the dots needed out of the life I was about to live, sat down under the hot water and it felt like a vivid dream. This substance relocates the people I don't tend to communicate with in those dreams, I see faces I don't know but appreciate. My trust is always given in hand of others. The shower felt quite fast when I opened my eyes but I cleaned myself like I should've done a long time ago. The music was walking with me, it wasn't done. Being sensible to sound I asked myself if it was too much? But I had to do something to add up to it. Never raking it. Rolled up a fine jay, sat out, looked up and let my mind create the atmosphere around me for the sake of what I was seeing. Slept really good.
[Reported Substances: Ketamine & Cannabis]
